question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
WITH orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT b.ORDER_ID, COALESCE(r.ITEM_LINE_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_LINE_COUNT, r.ITEM_QUANTITY
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE b
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP r
    ON b.ORDER_ID = r.ORDER_ID
  WHERE b.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND b.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_2025_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) AS MULTI_LINE_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS MULTI_LINE_SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS,
  AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ONE_LINE_ORDER,
  AVG(IFF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1, ITEM_QUANTITY, NULL)) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_MULTI_LINE_ORDER,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) AS NO_ITEM_LINE_ORDERS,
  COUNT_IF(ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::FLOAT AS NO_ITEM_LINE_SHARE_OF_ALL_ORDERS
FROM orders_2025
action.metrics: 2025 order counts and shares; average item quantity per one-line and multi-line order

action.answer: For orders with a recorded order date in 2025 (4,359,773 orders total), 3,052,089 had more than one item line: 70.005686% of all orders. Average ordered units were 1.219753 units per one-line order and 3.484769 units per multi-line order. Separately, 0 orders had no item line (0.000000% of all orders).
